verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card with rewards for AI vendor spend. Mileage and per-diem expense capture is a fair question for a corporate card or spend product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions mileage logging, map-based distance, per-diem rates, or automatic expense creation; it covers only rewards, partner perks, travel booking, and card requests.

support.subject: As an employee, I can log mileage with map-based distance and claim per-diem rates without building the expense by hand
